title: About Mikhtav
body: Mikhtav explains common Israeli bureaucratic letters and links them to public official documents. The original PDFs are preserved unchanged; translated titles and explanations are editorial content. Forms and information pages are not personal notices. Verify your own letter with the issuing authority.

purpose.title: Understand your next step
purpose.body: Mikhtav helps newcomers understand common Israeli letters and prepare their next action. Compare the guide with the heading and sender on your own letter.

originals.title: Originals and explanations
originals.body: Official documents are unchanged public originals. Translated titles, explanations and action lists are editorial guidance, not a translation of your personal notice.

sources.title: How sources are used
sources.body: Each explanation links to supporting official sources with a check date. Document retrieval dates show when a file was obtained, not a professional review or a guarantee that it is current. Verify amounts and deadlines with the authority.

progress.title: Your progress stays here
progress.body: Checklist marks are stored only in this browser. No account or upload is needed. Clearing browser data removes them; a changed action version starts a new checklist.
